name: LANCETTA
description:
About This Game


💠QUICK GAME LOOP OVERVIEW

You are playing as "Master Pilots", Combat Androids capable of performing unrealistic maneuvers on foot or from the cockpit of their Rifters. Pilot's roles are to provide combat support and clear all objectives in their assigned sectors through battles of attrition. Customize and upgrade your registered Pilots until the battlefield claims them.

💠MADE EXCLUSIVELY FOR PC

Ultra-Wide + 4k support at high frame rates. Pilot and flight controls are made for Keyboard and Mouse. Gamepad / Controller support will be available at the full release.

💠DISCOVER RANDOMIZED PILOTS EVERY TIME

Choices and progressions are integrated with every Pilot (Rifters, Weapons, Abilities, Appearance, Name, ETC) which you can change by performing well with them. The Pilot rotation has a wide variety of items to ensure their discovery is still interesting for a long time. 

💠FAST & DIVERSE COMBAT

As a Pilot, combine Melee Attacks, Abilities, Weapons to outmatch enemy infantry. In flight, unleash powerful Particle Beams on your enemies, unlock the full potential of your Rifter's phases each with specialized traits and playstyles.

💠LETHAL AIR-TO-SURFACE TRANSITIONS

Exit your Rifter's cockpit and dive straight into your enemies to instantly finish them off.

💠TACTICAL APPROACH TO MISSION SELECT

Each mission has unique sets of modifiers (think of them as mostly enemy upgrades) that will often make you think twice before sortie. Decide which ones are ideal for you or your Pilots and keep a vigilant eye for any potential lethal modifier combinations.

💠DYNAMIC COMBAT MUSIC TRACKS

Game and music made by the same solo dev, Liquid DNB serves as the main inspiration for the LANCETTA OST in a style that fits his vision.

You can listen to the OST by clicking the YouTube link in the sidebar.
short_desc: Discover and upgrade randomized Pilots in this 2-IN-1 Aerial & Ground combat, Third Person Roguelite inspired by Fast Movement Shooters and Mecha Pilot aesthetics.
